reviews.summary: MAGIC has venue-flow risk: Phemex delisted MAGIC/USDT on September 15, while BingX opened MAGIC/USDT trading on October 10. This recent liquidity migration can amplify volatility and execution uncertainty.
materialRisks: Phemex delisted the MAGIC/USDT spot pair and halted MAGIC deposits and withdrawals effective September 15, 2026; this is a direct reduction in venue availability. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100356?utm_source=openai))

BingX opened MAGIC/USDT spot trading on October 10, 2026. A just-launched venue can concentrate speculative flow and add short-term, fragmented-liquidity risk. ([bingxservice.zendesk.com](https://bingxservice.zendesk.com/hc/es/articles/17937264821007-Treasure-MAGIC-ser%C3%A1-listada-en-BingX-Spot?utm_source=openai))

facts.fact: Treasure/MAGIC’s official status page reports no incidents in October 2026 and no scheduled maintenance. ([status.magic.dev](https://status.magic.dev/incidents?utm_source=openai))

Phemex’s delisting notice states MAGIC/USDT was removed at 07:00 UTC on September 15, 2026, with deposits and withdrawals unavailable thereafter. ([phemex.com](https://phemex.com/announcements/phemex-will-delist-the-perp-usdt-spot-pair-100356?utm_source=openai))

BingX announced MAGIC/USDT deposits, trading, and withdrawals beginning October 10, 2026, using the Arbitrum network. ([bingxservice.zendesk.com](https://bingxservice.zendesk.com/hc/es/articles/17937264821007-Treasure-MAGIC-ser%C3%A1-listada-en-BingX-Spot?utm_source=openai))
